description: Screen a person, company or vessel name against four official sanctions lists at once: EU consolidated list, US OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions List (FCDO, incl. HM Treasury/OFSI asset freezes) and the UN Security Council Consolidated List. Returns each match with list, programme, reference, match_score and matched_alias. Screening aid only; human review required. Price 0.03 USD per call via x402.

lists.description: Optional comma-separated subset of eu,ofac,uk,un (default all four)

name: sanctions_screen_global
